AITA for revealing to a prospective employer of my former employee that he shares pay information with coworkers, possibly costing him a job? | To preface this, I run a small business with fewer than 20 employees. I have a former employee who we will call Adam. I believe he was just venting and has no actual intention of filing a lawsuit. 

The way I see it is, at the end of the day all I did was relay the facts. Adam was the one to engage in the questionable behavior, and XYZ company was the one to turn him down for the job based on this behavior. So am I the asshole here?

AITA for telling students they could leave | This was a while ago, but reading this sub got me wondering about it. 

A few years ago I was attending a community college. I also worked there, work-study, as a tutor. 2 days a week I sat in on the class I tutored for and helped students.

It's true I didn't search hard for his office, by then I was kind of annoyed at wasting an afternoon when I had work of my own to do.
